key.name: history-size
key.summary: Maximum number of clipboard entries kept in memory

key.name: skip-password-manager
key.summary: Never store entries flagged secret by password managers
key.description: Honors the x-kde-passwordManagerHint used by Bitwarden, KeePassXC, 1Password, etc.

key.name: conceal-sensitive
key.summary: Auto-mask entries that look like secrets
key.description: Tokens, JWTs, API keys and private keys are stored masked and never previewed in plain text.

key.name: clear-on-lock
key.summary: Wipe all history when the screen locks

key.name: max-entry-length
key.summary: Skip clipboard content larger than this many characters

key.name: capture-images
key.summary: Also capture images copied to the clipboard

key.name: max-image-mb
key.summary: Skip images larger than this many megabytes

key.name: sensitive-ttl
key.summary: Seconds after which a masked/sensitive entry is auto-removed (0 = off)

key.name: idle-clear-minutes
key.summary: Wipe all history after this many minutes of inactivity (0 = off)

key.name: exclusion-patterns
key.summary: Regular expressions; matching clipboard content is never stored

key.name: app-blocklist
key.summary: WM_CLASS substrings; clipboard from a matching app is never stored

key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to open the clipboard menu
